text: so how do we make it faster. it blows ass when one thing changes and we sit through that hell 40 times a day, there is literally a script made to clear the zig cache because we have to build so often. so how can we do incremental compiles ? >99% of the code does not change per build
resolution: Diagnosed the 124-second native dev rebuild as a monolithic ReleaseFast LLVM compilation: build.zig creates one application root module, rjit dev enables nearly every capability, and v8_app/engine/core bindings directly import 3D and game implementations. Confirmed Zig 0.16 supports opt-in incremental watch mode but leaves it disabled by default and LLVM still re-emits the changed compilation unit. Defined the corrective architecture: separate compiled cold-core, scene-3D, and game/world artifacts behind stable ABI tables, a tiny launcher, per-tier fingerprints/caches, and non-incremental release verification.
